```{r}
library(ggplot2)

library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(clusterProfiler)
```

```{r}
# Set the project directory and the data directory

project_dir <- "D:/Yibo Main/BE5350 Final Project"
raw_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "data", "raw")

list.files(raw_dir)
```

```{r}
# Inspect the data in both files

count_files <- untar(
  file.path(raw_dir, "GSE175759_RAW.tar"), 
  list = TRUE
)

length(count_files)
head(count_files)
```

```{r}
# Extract the samples from GSE175759_RAW.tar to a new folder named "counts"
counts_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "data", "counts")
dir.create(counts_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

untar(
  file.path(raw_dir, "GSE175759_RAW.tar"),
  exdir = counts_dir
)

sample_files <- list.files(
  counts_dir, 
  pattern = "\\.txt\\.gz$", 
  full.names = TRUE
)

length(sample_files)
head(basename(sample_files))
```

```{r}
# Read each compressed count file into a list of data frames
count_tables <- lapply(
  sample_files,
  read.delim,
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Use GEO sample accessions as column names for matching to metadata later
sample_ids <- sub("_.*$", "", basename(sample_files))

# Use the first file's gene order as the reference
gene_ids <- count_tables[[1]]$id

# Confirm unique sample IDs and the same unique genes in every file
stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(sample_ids),
  all(vapply(count_tables, function(x) {
    !anyDuplicated(x$id) && setequal(x$id, gene_ids)
  }, logical(1)))
)

# Align each sample by gene ID, then combine its counts into a matrix
count_matrix <- do.call(
  cbind,
  lapply(count_tables, function(x) {
    x[[2]][match(gene_ids, x$id)]
  })
)

rownames(count_matrix) <- gene_ids
colnames(count_matrix) <- sample_ids

# Check that the matrix contains valid, nonnegative whole-number counts
stopifnot(
  is.numeric(count_matrix),
  all(is.finite(count_matrix)),
  all(count_matrix >= 0),
  all(count_matrix == floor(count_matrix))
)

message("Count matrix checks passed.")

# Inspect the dimensions and a small section
dim(count_matrix)
count_matrix[1:6, 1:5]
```

```{r}
# Read the compressed metadata file as lines of text
metadata_lines <- readLines(
  gzfile(file.path(raw_dir, "GSE175759_series_matrix.txt.gz"))
)

# Pick the necessary information and store it
sample_lines <- grep(
  "^!Sample_(title|geo_accession|characteristics_ch1)\\t", 
  metadata_lines, 
  value = TRUE
)
length(sample_lines)
sample_lines
```

```{r}
# Find the necessary information
title_line <- grep("^!Sample_title\t", metadata_lines, value = TRUE)
id_line <- grep("^!Sample_geo_accession\t", metadata_lines, value = TRUE)
diagnosis_line <- grep(
  '^!Sample_characteristics_ch1\t"diagnosis:',
  metadata_lines,
  value = TRUE
)
outlier_line <- grep(
  '^!Sample_characteristics_ch1\t"technical outlier:',
  metadata_lines, 
  value = TRUE
)
egfr_line <- grep(
  '^!Sample_characteristics_ch1\t"estimated gfr',
  metadata_lines, 
  value = TRUE
)

# Check if the search for only one line
stopifnot(
  length(title_line) == 1L,
  length(id_line) == 1L,
  length(diagnosis_line) == 1L,
  length(outlier_line) == 1L,
  length(egfr_line) == 1L
)

# Separate them by tabs
sample_titles <- strsplit(title_line, "\t")[[1]][-1]
geo_ids <- strsplit(id_line, "\t")[[1]][-1]
diagnoses <- strsplit(diagnosis_line, "\t")[[1]][-1]
outlier_labels <- strsplit(outlier_line, "\t")[[1]][-1]
egfr_values <- strsplit(egfr_line, "\t")[[1]][-1]

# Clean up the data
sample_titles <- gsub('"', "", sample_titles)
geo_ids <- gsub('"', "", geo_ids)
diagnoses <- gsub('"', "", diagnoses)
diagnoses <- sub("^diagnosis: ", "", diagnoses)
outlier_labels <- gsub('"', "", outlier_labels)
outlier_labels <- sub("^technical outlier: ", "", outlier_labels)
egfr_values <- gsub('"', "", egfr_values)
egfr_values <- sub(
  "estimated gfr (ckd-epi): ", 
  "", egfr_values,
  fixed = TRUE
  )

# Create the table
sample_info <- data.frame(
  sample_id = geo_ids, 
  title = sample_titles, 
  diagnosis = diagnoses,
  technical_outlier = outlier_labels, 
  egfr = as.numeric(egfr_values),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

dim(sample_info)
head(sample_info)
str(sample_info)
```

```{r}
# Check that sample IDs are unique and match the count matrix
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(sample_info$sample_id))
stopifnot(setequal(sample_info$sample_id, colnames(count_matrix)))

# Arrange metadata rows to follow the count-column order
sample_info <- sample_info %>%
  dplyr::arrange(match(sample_id, colnames(count_matrix)))

# Use sample IDs as row names
rownames(sample_info) <- sample_info$sample_id

# Confirm that the order matches exactly
stopifnot(identical(rownames(sample_info), colnames(count_matrix)))
message("Sample IDs are unique and metadata order matches the count matrix.")
```

```{r}
# Select IgAN and Control group for the following analysis
igan_control <- sample_info %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    diagnosis %in% c("IgAN", "Control"),
    technical_outlier == "No"
  )
igan_control_counts <- count_matrix[, igan_control$sample_id, drop = FALSE]

table(igan_control$diagnosis)
stopifnot(identical(colnames(igan_control_counts), igan_control$sample_id))
message("Sample Selection Success")
```

```{r}
# Create a QC table with sample IDs and diagnoses
sample_qc <- igan_control %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, diagnosis) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    total_counts = colSums(igan_control_counts),
    detected_genes = colSums(igan_control_counts > 0)
  )

sample_qc %>% select(total_counts, detected_genes) %>%
  summary()
sample_qc
```

```{r}
# A box plot to show the library size of the two groups
group_sizes <- table(igan_control$diagnosis)

IgAN_Control_Library_Plot <- ggplot(
  sample_qc,
  aes(x = diagnosis, y = total_counts / 1e6)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.45,
    coef = 1.5,
```

```{r}
# Calculate the fraction of counts assigned to each sample's top 10 genes
top10_fraction <- apply(igan_control_counts, 2, function(x) {
  top10_counts <- sort(x, decreasing = TRUE)[1:10]
  sum(top10_counts) / sum(x)
})

# Samples flagged in the QC plots
flagged_samples <- c("GSM5345939", "GSM5345942")

# Add the percentages to the QC table
concentration_qc <- sample_qc %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    top10_percent = unname(100 * top10_fraction[sample_id]),
    flagged = sample_id %in% flagged_samples
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(top10_percent))

# Show the flagged samples
concentration_qc %>%
  dplyr::filter(flagged)

# Show the five samples with the highest count concentration
concentration_qc %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 5)
```

```{r}
# Determine the size of the smaller group
min_samples <- min(table(igan_control$diagnosis))

# Identify genes with at least 10 counts in enough samples
keep_genes <- rowSums(igan_control_counts >= 10) >= min_samples

# Keep those genes and all sample columns
counts_filtered <- igan_control_counts[keep_genes, , drop = FALSE]

# Summarize the filtering
c(
  genes_before = nrow(igan_control_counts),
  genes_retained = sum(keep_genes),
  genes_removed = sum(!keep_genes)
)

dim(counts_filtered)
```

```{r}
# Define the groups, with Control as the reference
igan_control <- igan_control %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    diagnosis = factor(diagnosis, levels = c("Control", "IgAN"))
  )

# Use sample IDs as metadata row names
rownames(igan_control) <- igan_control$sample_id

# Confirm that metadata rows match count columns

  identical(colnames(counts_filtered), rownames(igan_control))

# Create the DESeq2 dataset
dds <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
```

```{r}
# Fit the model and perform the default Wald tests
dds <- DESeq2::DESeq(dds)

# Inspect the available model coefficients
DESeq2::resultsNames(dds)

res <- DESeq2::results(
  dds,
  contrast = c("diagnosis", "IgAN", "Control"),
  alpha = 0.05
)

summary(res)
```

```{r}
# Check whether model fitting converged for every gene
table(S4Vectors::mcols(dds)$betaConv, useNA = "ifany")

# Inspect gene-wise and fitted dispersion estimates
DESeq2::plotDispEsts(dds)

# Distribution of raw p-values
hist(res$pvalue, breaks = 50, main = "Raw p-values", xlab = "p-value")
```

```{r}
# Stabilize the log2 fold-change estimates
res_shrunk <- DESeq2::lfcShrink(
  dds,
  coef = "diagnosis_IgAN_vs_Control",
  res = res,
  type = "apeglm"
)

# MA plot of the unshrunken fold changes
DESeq2::plotMA(
  res,
  alpha = 0.05,
  ylim = c(-5, 5),
  main = "Before shrinkage"
)

# MA plot of the shrunken fold changes
DESeq2::plotMA(
  res_shrunk,
  alpha = 0.05,
  ylim = c(-5, 5),
  main = "After shrinkage (apeglm)"
)
```

```{r}
# Confirm matching gene order
stopifnot(identical(rownames(res), rownames(res_shrunk)))

# Inspect the recorded shrinkage method
DESeq2::priorInfo(res_shrunk)

# Summarize the absolute change in log2 fold change
lfc_change <- abs(
  res_shrunk$log2FoldChange - res$log2FoldChange
)

summary(lfc_change)
```

```{r}
# Build a results table and add Ensembl IDs without version numbers
results_annotated <- as.data.frame(res_shrunk) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene_id = rownames(res_shrunk),
    ensembl_id = sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", gene_id)
  )

# Look up human gene symbols
gene_symbols <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = unique(results_annotated$ensembl_id),
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  column = "SYMBOL",
  multiVals = "asNA"
)

# Match each symbol to its Ensembl ID
results_annotated <- results_annotated %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene_symbol = unname(gene_symbols[ensembl_id])
  ) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(gene_id, ensembl_id, gene_symbol) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(padj)

# Check how many genes received a symbol
results_annotated %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_genes = dplyr::n(),
    with_symbol = sum(!is.na(gene_symbol)),
    without_symbol = sum(is.na(gene_symbol))
  )
```

```{r}
# Take the Volcano data assembled
volcano_data <- results_annotated %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(padj),
    is.finite(log2FoldChange)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    significance = dplyr::case_when(
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "Higher in IgAN",
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "Lower in IgAN",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    ),
    neg_log10_padj = -log10(pmax(padj, .Machine$double.xmin))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(padj < 0.05)
```

```{r}
# Plot expression differences and statistical evidence
IgAN_Control_volcano_Plot <- ggplot(
  volcano_data,
  aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neg_log10_padj)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.05),
    linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(-1, 1),
    linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = significance),
    shape = 16, size = 1.3, alpha = 0.65
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Higher in IgAN" = "#D55E00",
      "Lower in IgAN" = "#0072B2",
      "Not significant" = "grey75"
    ),
    breaks = c(
      "Higher in IgAN", "Lower in IgAN", "Not significant"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "IgAN versus Control",
    x = "Shrunken log2 fold change (IgAN / Control)",
    y = expression(-log[10]("adjusted p-value")),
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.4)
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)
  ))

# Select the five most significant named genes in each direction
top_genes <- volcano_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(gene_symbol),
    significance != "Not significant"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(significance) %>%
  dplyr::slice_min(order_by = pvalue, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Add gene labels to the existing volcano plot
IgAN_Control_volcano_Plot_labeled <- IgAN_Control_volcano_Plot +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = top_genes,
    aes(
      x = log2FoldChange,
      y = neg_log10_padj,
      label = gene_symbol
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    fontface = "italic",
    size = 3,
    box.padding = 0.5,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.color = "grey50",
    segment.size = 0.3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    seed = 5350
  ) +
  labs(
    caption = paste(
  "Significance: BH-adjusted p < 0.05 (horizontal line).",
  "Vertical lines mark shrunken log2 fold changes of ±1 (twofold differences); they are not used to define significance.",
  "Labels: five named genes with the smallest raw p-values in each direction among genes with BH-adjusted p < 0.05.",
  sep = "\n"
)
  ) +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0))
IgAN_Control_volcano_Plot_labeled
```

```{r}
print(tibble::as_tibble(top_gene_table), n = 10, width = Inf)
```

```{r}
# Normalized counts for the labeled genes
selected_counts <- DESeq2::counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)[
  top_gene_table$gene_id, , drop = FALSE
]

# Summarize each gene within each diagnosis group
gene_inspection <- lapply(top_gene_table$gene_id, function(gene) {
  data.frame(
    gene_id = gene,
    diagnosis = dds$diagnosis,
    normalized_count = selected_counts[gene, ]
  ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(gene_id, diagnosis) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_samples = dplyr::n(),
      median_count = median(normalized_count),
      min_count = min(normalized_count),
      max_count = max(normalized_count),
      samples_with_zero = sum(normalized_count == 0),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    top_gene_table %>%
      dplyr::select(gene_id, gene_symbol, log2FoldChange),
    by = "gene_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(gene_symbol, .after = gene_id)

print(tibble::as_tibble(gene_inspection), n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

```{r}
# Inspect the stored matrices
SummarizedExperiment::assayNames(dds)

# Original Cook's distances: genes in rows, samples in columns
cooks <- SummarizedExperiment::assays(dds)[["cooks"]]

# Default cutoff: 99th percentile of the F distribution
model_matrix <- model.matrix(
  DESeq2::design(dds),
  data = as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::colData(dds))
)

n_parameters <- ncol(model_matrix)

cooks_cutoff <- qf(
  0.99,
  df1 = n_parameters,
  df2 = ncol(dds) - n_parameters
)

cooks_cutoff
```

```{r}
original_counts <- DESeq2::counts(dds)

# Start with no changed entries
counts_changed <- matrix(
  FALSE,
  nrow = nrow(dds),
  ncol = ncol(dds),
  dimnames = dimnames(original_counts)
)

if ("replaceCounts" %in% SummarizedExperiment::assayNames(dds)) {
  replacement_counts <-
    SummarizedExperiment::assays(dds)[["replaceCounts"]]

  counts_changed <- replacement_counts != original_counts
}

c(
  changed_counts = sum(counts_changed),
  genes_with_changed_counts = sum(rowSums(counts_changed) > 0),
  samples_with_changed_counts = sum(colSums(counts_changed) > 0)
)
```

```{r}
# Create an unfitted dataset for the controlled comparison
dds_sens_unadjusted <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = DESeq2::counts(dds, normalized = FALSE),
  colData = egfr_coldata,
  design = ~ diagnosis
)

DESeq2::sizeFactors(dds_sens_unadjusted) <-
  DESeq2::sizeFactors(dds)

# Copy before fitting, then add eGFR to the second model
dds_sens_egfr <- dds_sens_unadjusted
DESeq2::design(dds_sens_egfr) <- ~ egfr_10 + diagnosis

# Disable automatic count replacement in both models
dds_sens_unadjusted <- DESeq2::DESeq(
  dds_sens_unadjusted,
  minReplicatesForReplace = Inf
)

dds_sens_egfr <- DESeq2::DESeq(
  dds_sens_egfr,
  minReplicatesForReplace = Inf
)
```

```{r}
# Extract unshrunken diagnosis effects using identical settings
res_sens_unadjusted <- DESeq2::results(
  dds_sens_unadjusted,
  contrast = c("diagnosis", "IgAN", "Control"),
  alpha = 0.05,
  cooksCutoff = FALSE,
  independentFiltering = FALSE
)

res_sens_egfr <- DESeq2::results(
  dds_sens_egfr,
  contrast = c("diagnosis", "IgAN", "Control"),
  alpha = 0.05,
  cooksCutoff = FALSE,
  independentFiltering = FALSE
)

# Check convergence
table(
  S4Vectors::mcols(dds_sens_unadjusted)$betaConv,
  useNA = "ifany"
)

table(
  S4Vectors::mcols(dds_sens_egfr)$betaConv,
  useNA = "ifany"
)

summary(res_sens_unadjusted)
summary(res_sens_egfr)

DESeq2::plotDispEsts(dds_sens_unadjusted)
DESeq2::plotDispEsts(dds_sens_egfr)
```

```{r}
# Confirm matching inputs and result rows
stopifnot(
  identical(
    rownames(dds_sens_unadjusted),
    rownames(dds_sens_egfr)
  ),
  identical(
    colnames(dds_sens_unadjusted),
    colnames(dds_sens_egfr)
  ),
  identical(
    DESeq2::counts(dds_sens_unadjusted),
    DESeq2::counts(dds_sens_egfr)
  ),
  isTRUE(all.equal(
    DESeq2::sizeFactors(dds_sens_unadjusted),
    DESeq2::sizeFactors(dds_sens_egfr)
  )),
  identical(
    rownames(res_sens_unadjusted),
    rownames(dds_sens_unadjusted)
  ),
  identical(
    rownames(res_sens_egfr),
    rownames(dds_sens_egfr)
  ),
  !anyDuplicated(rownames(res_sens_unadjusted)),
  !anyDuplicated(rownames(res_sens_egfr))
)

# Prepare the unshrunken results from each model
unadjusted_table <- as.data.frame(res_sens_unadjusted) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene_id,
    lfc_unadjusted = log2FoldChange,
    se_unadjusted = lfcSE,
    padj_unadjusted = padj
  )

egfr_table <- as.data.frame(res_sens_egfr) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene_id,
    lfc_egfr = log2FoldChange,
    se_egfr = lfcSE,
    padj_egfr = padj
  )

# Compare diagnosis effects gene by gene
model_comparison <- unadjusted_table %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(egfr_table, by = "gene_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    lfc_change = lfc_egfr - lfc_unadjusted,
    abs_lfc_change = abs(lfc_egfr) - abs(lfc_unadjusted),
    direction_changed = sign(lfc_egfr) != sign(lfc_unadjusted),
    se_change = se_egfr - se_unadjusted,
    significance_status = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(padj_unadjusted) | is.na(padj_egfr) ~
        "Not evaluable in both",
      padj_unadjusted < 0.05 & padj_egfr < 0.05 ~
        "Significant in both",
      padj_unadjusted < 0.05 ~ "Unadjusted only",
      padj_egfr < 0.05 ~ "eGFR-adjusted only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    )
  )

# Check for unavailable adjusted p-values
model_comparison %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    missing_unadjusted = sum(is.na(padj_unadjusted)),
    missing_egfr = sum(is.na(padj_egfr)),
    different_missing_status = sum(
      is.na(padj_unadjusted) != is.na(padj_egfr)
    )
  )

# Count genes in each significance category
model_comparison %>%
  dplyr::count(significance_status, name = "number_of_genes")

# Inspect the ten largest shifts in diagnosis effect
model_comparison %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(lfc_change))) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

```{r}
# Keep genes with finite estimates in both models

# Summarize agreement
lfc_correlation <- cor(
  agreement_data$lfc_unadjusted,
  agreement_data$lfc_egfr,

)

median_lfc_difference <- median(
  abs(agreement_data$lfc_egfr - agreement_data$lfc_unadjusted)

# Use the same range on both axes
axis_limits <- range(

# Draw nonsignificant genes first

  dplyr::mutate(
    significance_status = factor(

        "Significant in both",

      )

  dplyr::arrange(significance_status)

IgAN_Control_lfc_agreement_plot <- ggplot(

  ),

    "Unshrunken estimates; dashed line indicates identical estimates.",

    ),
    sep = "\n"

) +

    )
```

```{r}
# Start with primary results eligible for significance assessment
enrichment_input <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(padj)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ensembl_id = sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", gene_id),
    direction = dplyr::case_when(
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "Higher in IgAN",
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "Lower in IgAN",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

# Retrieve every candidate mapping
mapping_pairs <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = unique(enrichment_input$ensembl_id),
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  columns = "ENTREZID"
) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(ENSEMBL, ENTREZID)

# Keep one row per Ensembl ID and classify the mapping
mapping_table <- mapping_pairs %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ENSEMBL) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    candidates = list(unique(ENTREZID[!is.na(ENTREZID)])),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_entrez = lengths(candidates),
    mapping_status = dplyr::case_when(
      n_entrez == 0 ~ "Unmapped",
      n_entrez == 1 ~ "Unique",
      n_entrez > 1 ~ "Ambiguous"
    ),
    entrez_id = vapply(
      candidates,
      function(x) {
        if (length(x) == 1) as.character(x) else NA_character_
      },
      character(1)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(ensembl_id = ENSEMBL)

# Apply the same mapping to every input gene
enrichment_mapped <- enrichment_input %>%
  dplyr::left_join(mapping_table, by = "ensembl_id")

stopifnot(
  nrow(enrichment_mapped) == nrow(enrichment_input),
  !anyNA(enrichment_mapped$mapping_status)
)

enrichment_mapped %>%
  dplyr::count(direction, mapping_status, name = "n_input_genes")
```

```{r}
# Define the three lists before excluding mapping failures
input_lists <- list(
  Background = enrichment_mapped,
  Higher = enrichment_mapped %>%
    dplyr::filter(direction == "Higher in IgAN"),
  Lower = enrichment_mapped %>%
    dplyr::filter(direction == "Lower in IgAN")
)

mapping_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(names(input_lists), function(list_name) {
    x <- input_lists[[list_name]]
    mapped_ids <- x$entrez_id[x$mapping_status == "Unique"]

    tibble::tibble(
      gene_list = list_name,
      input_gene_rows = nrow(x),
      unmapped_rows = sum(x$mapping_status == "Unmapped"),
      ambiguous_rows = sum(x$mapping_status == "Ambiguous"),
      uniquely_mapped_rows = length(mapped_ids),
      unique_entrez_ids = length(unique(mapped_ids)),
      duplicate_entrez_entries = length(mapped_ids) -
        length(unique(mapped_ids))
    )
  })
)

print(mapping_summary, n = Inf, width = Inf)

# Retain mapping failures for inspection
unmapped_genes <- enrichment_mapped %>%
  dplyr::filter(mapping_status == "Unmapped")

ambiguous_genes <- enrichment_mapped %>%
  dplyr::filter(mapping_status == "Ambiguous") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene_id, ensembl_id, direction, candidates
  )

print(tibble::as_tibble(ambiguous_genes), n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

```{r}
# Retain only unambiguous Ensembl-to-Entrez mappings
mapped_unique <- enrichment_mapped %>%
  dplyr::filter(mapping_status == "Unique")

background_genes <- unique(mapped_unique$entrez_id)

up_before_conflicts <- mapped_unique %>%
  dplyr::filter(direction == "Higher in IgAN") %>%
  dplyr::pull(entrez_id) %>%
  unique()

down_before_conflicts <- mapped_unique %>%
  dplyr::filter(direction == "Lower in IgAN") %>%
  dplyr::pull(entrez_id) %>%
  unique()

# Find Entrez IDs represented in both significant directions
conflicting_entrez <- intersect(
  up_before_conflicts,
  down_before_conflicts
)

# Show all contributing input rows for these IDs
direction_conflicts <- mapped_unique %>%
  dplyr::filter(entrez_id %in% conflicting_entrez) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    entrez_id, gene_id, ensembl_id,
    direction, log2FoldChange, padj
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(entrez_id, direction)

print(
  tibble::as_tibble(direction_conflicts),
  n = Inf,
  width = Inf
)

# Exclude conflicting IDs from both directional lists
up_genes <- setdiff(up_before_conflicts, conflicting_entrez)
down_genes <- setdiff(down_before_conflicts, conflicting_entrez)

# Verify the final lists
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(background_genes),
  !anyNA(up_genes),
  !anyNA(down_genes),
  !anyDuplicated(background_genes),
  !anyDuplicated(up_genes),
  !anyDuplicated(down_genes),
  all(up_genes %in% background_genes),
  all(down_genes %in% background_genes),
  length(intersect(up_genes, down_genes)) == 0
)

final_list_counts <- tibble::tibble(
  gene_list = c("Background", "Higher in IgAN", "Lower in IgAN"),
  unique_entrez_before_conflict_resolution = c(
    length(background_genes),
    length(up_before_conflicts),
    length(down_before_conflicts)
  ),
  conflicting_ids_removed = c(
    0L,
    length(conflicting_entrez),
    length(conflicting_entrez)
  ),
  final_unique_entrez_ids = c(
    length(background_genes),
    length(up_genes),
    length(down_genes)
  )
)

print(final_list_counts, n = Inf, width = Inf)

# Record the annotation version
packageVersion("org.Hs.eg.db")
```

```{r}
# Apply the same GO Biological Process settings to each gene list
run_go_bp <- function(gene_ids) {
  clusterProfiler::enrichGO(
    gene = gene_ids,
    universe = background_genes,
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
    keyType = "ENTREZID",
    ont = "BP",
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    pvalueCutoff = 1,
    qvalueCutoff = 1,
    minGSSize = 10,
    maxGSSize = 500,
    readable = FALSE
  )
}

go_up <- run_go_bp(up_genes)
go_down <- run_go_bp(down_genes)
```

```{r}
# Convert enrichment results to tables
go_up_table <- as.data.frame(go_up) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p.adjust)

go_down_table <- as.data.frame(go_down) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p.adjust)

# Apply the planned significance criterion
go_up_significant <- go_up_table %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(p.adjust), p.adjust < 0.05)

go_down_significant <- go_down_table %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(p.adjust), p.adjust < 0.05)

# Summarize the returned and significant terms

  direction = c("Higher in IgAN", "Lower in IgAN"),
  submitted_genes = c(length(up_genes), length(down_genes)),
  returned_terms = c(nrow(go_up_table), nrow(go_down_table)),
  significant_terms = c(
    nrow(go_up_significant),
    nrow(go_down_significant)
  )
)

print(go_summary, width = Inf)
```

```{r}
# Simplify significant terms in a separate copy of each result
simplify_go_bp <- function(go_result, significant_table) {
  presentation_result <- go_result

  # Only significant terms enter the presentation selection
  presentation_result@result <- as.data.frame(significant_table)

  if (nrow(significant_table) < 2) {
    return(presentation_result)
  }

  clusterProfiler::simplify(
    presentation_result,
    cutoff = 0.7,
    by = "p.adjust",
    select_fun = min,
    measure = "Wang"
  )
}

go_up_simplified <- simplify_go_bp(go_up, go_up_significant)
go_down_simplified <- simplify_go_bp(go_down, go_down_significant)

# Keep all retained representative terms
go_up_representative <- as.data.frame(go_up_simplified) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p.adjust)

go_down_representative <- as.data.frame(go_down_simplified) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p.adjust)

# Check how many terms remain for presentation
redundancy_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  direction = c("Higher in IgAN", "Lower in IgAN"),
  significant_terms = c(
    nrow(go_up_significant),
    nrow(go_down_significant)
  ),
  representative_terms = c(
    nrow(go_up_representative),
    nrow(go_down_representative)
  )
)

print(redundancy_summary, width = Inf)

# Select up to eight representative terms per direction for the figure
go_plot_terms <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  go_up_representative %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 8) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(direction = "Higher in IgAN"),

  go_down_representative %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 8) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(direction = "Lower in IgAN")
)

go_plot_terms %>%
  dplyr::select(direction, ID, Description, p.adjust, Count) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

```{r}
# Convert GeneRatio from a fraction into a number
go_figure_data <- go_plot_terms %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene_ratio = vapply(
      strsplit(as.character(GeneRatio), "/", fixed = TRUE),
      function(x) as.numeric(x[1]) / as.numeric(x[2]),
      numeric(1)
    ),
    significance_score = -log10(
  pmax(p.adjust, .Machine$double.xmin)
),
    direction = factor(
      direction,
      levels = c("Higher in IgAN", "Lower in IgAN")
    ),
    term_key = paste(direction, ID, sep = "__")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(direction, p.adjust)

# Put the most significant term at the top of each panel
go_figure_data$term_key <- factor(
  go_figure_data$term_key,
  levels = rev(go_figure_data$term_key)
)

# Wrap long term names
term_labels <- setNames(
  vapply(
    go_figure_data$Description,
    function(x) paste(strwrap(x, width = 40), collapse = "\n"),
    character(1)
  ),
  as.character(go_figure_data$term_key)
)

GO_final <- ggplot(
  go_figure_data,
  aes(
    x = gene_ratio,
    y = term_key,
    size = Count,
    color = significance_score
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.95) +
  facet_grid(
    direction ~ .,
    scales = "free_y",

  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = term_labels) +

  labs(
    title = "GO Biological Process enrichment",
    subtitle = "IgAN versus Control",
    x = "Percentage of GO BP-annotated input genes",
    y = NULL,
    caption = paste(
  "Eight representative terms per direction; BH-adjusted p < 0.05.",
  "Redundancy reduced using Wang similarity (cutoff 0.7).",
  "'Negative regulation of myoblast fusion' includes 37 contributing",

)
```

## Save analysis outputs

Run this section after all preceding analysis chunks. Outputs are saved under
`results` in the project directory. Re-running it replaces files with the same
names. Inspect the exported figures at their intended report size before use.

```{r}
#| label: export-tables
results_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "results")
tables_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "tables")
figures_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "figures")
objects_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "objects")
for (output_dir in c(results_dir, tables_dir, figures_dir, objects_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}
stopifnot(all(dir.exists(c(results_dir, tables_dir, figures_dir, objects_dir))))

# Keep gene IDs as explicit columns; primary Wald tests and shrunken effects
# are exported separately so the type of estimate is clear.
primary_results <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_id")

filtering_summary <- data.frame(
  genes_before = nrow(igan_control_counts),
  genes_retained = sum(keep_genes),
  genes_removed = sum(!keep_genes),
  minimum_count = 10,
  minimum_samples = min_samples
)
replacement_summary <- data.frame(
  changed_counts = sum(counts_changed),
  genes_with_changed_counts = sum(rowSums(counts_changed) > 0),
  samples_with_changed_counts = sum(colSums(counts_changed) > 0)
)
replacement_by_gene <- data.frame(
  gene_id = rownames(counts_changed),
  changed_counts = rowSums(counts_changed)
)
myoblast_evidence_summary <- myoblast_annotation %>%
  dplyr::group_by(EVIDENCEALL) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    number_of_genes = dplyr::n_distinct(ENTREZID), .groups = "drop"
  )
go_input_ids <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  data.frame(gene_list = "Background", entrez_id = background_genes),
  data.frame(gene_list = "Higher in IgAN", entrez_id = up_genes),
  data.frame(gene_list = "Lower in IgAN", entrez_id = down_genes)
)

output_tables <- list(
  sample_metadata_all = sample_info,
  sample_metadata_primary = igan_control,
  sample_qc = sample_qc,
  concentration_qc = concentration_qc,
  normalization_qc = normalization_qc,
  gene_filtering_summary = filtering_summary,
  pca_coordinates = pca_data,
  pca_variance = data.frame(component = c("PC1", "PC2"), percent = percent_variance),
  primary_DE_unshrunken = primary_results,
  primary_DE_apeglm_annotated = results_annotated,
  volcano_source_data = volcano_data,
  labelled_genes = top_gene_table,
  labelled_genes_group_counts = gene_inspection,
  labelled_genes_sample_counts = gene_plot_data,
  labelled_genes_cooks = top_gene_cooks,
  primary_count_replacement_summary = replacement_summary,
  primary_count_replacement_by_gene = replacement_by_gene,
  egfr_summary = egfr_summary,
  egfr_sample_values = egfr_metadata,
  sensitivity_unadjusted = tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(res_sens_unadjusted), "gene_id"),
  sensitivity_egfr_adjusted = tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(res_sens_egfr), "gene_id"),
  sensitivity_comparison = comparison_annotated,
  sensitivity_significance_counts = significance_counts,
  sensitivity_agreement = agreement_summary,
  sensitivity_largest_changes = largest_changes,
  sensitivity_labelled_genes = labelled_gene_comparison,
  sensitivity_significant_reversals = significant_reversals,
  go_mapping_summary = mapping_summary,
  go_mapping_all_genes = enrichment_mapped,
  go_unmapped_genes = unmapped_genes,
  go_ambiguous_genes = ambiguous_genes,
  go_direction_conflicts = direction_conflicts,
  go_final_list_counts = final_list_counts,
  go_submitted_entrez_ids = go_input_ids,
  go_enrichment_summary = go_summary,
  go_higher_all = go_up_table,
  go_lower_all = go_down_table,
  go_higher_significant = go_up_significant,
  go_lower_significant = go_down_significant,
  go_higher_representative = go_up_representative,
  go_lower_representative = go_down_representative,
  go_redundancy_summary = redundancy_summary,
  go_selected_terms = go_plot_terms,
  go_figure_source_data = go_figure_data,
  go_leading_term_contributors = go_contributing_genes,
  go_selected_term_contributors = selected_go_genes,
  go_selected_term_count_check = selected_go_check,
  go_myoblast_genes = myoblast_genes,
  go_myoblast_overlap = myoblast_overlap,
  go_myoblast_annotation = myoblast_annotation,
  go_myoblast_evidence_summary = myoblast_evidence_summary
)

for (table_name in names(output_tables)) {
  export_table <- as.data.frame(output_tables[[table_name]])
  # Candidate Entrez mappings are list columns. Preserve all candidates in CSV
  # using semicolons; the RDS copy below retains their original structure.
  list_columns <- vapply(export_table, is.list, logical(1))
  export_table[list_columns] <- lapply(export_table[list_columns], function(column) {
    vapply(column, function(values) paste(values, collapse = ";"), character(1))
  })
  utils::write.csv(
    export_table, file.path(tables_dir, paste0(table_name, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE, na = "NA", fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
  )
}
```

```{r}
# DESeq2 diagnostics use base graphics, so draw them inside an output device.
save_diagnostic <- function(name, draw_plot) {
  for (extension in c("pdf", "png")) {
    filename <- file.path(figures_dir, paste0(name, ".", extension))
    if (extension == "pdf") {
      grDevices::cairo_pdf(filename, width = 7, height = 5)
    } else {
      grDevices::png(filename, width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", res = 300)
    }
    tryCatch(draw_plot(), finally = grDevices::dev.off())
  }
}
save_diagnostic("primary_dispersion", function() DESeq2::plotDispEsts(dds))
save_diagnostic("sensitivity_unadjusted_dispersion", function() DESeq2::plotDispEsts(dds_sens_unadjusted))
save_diagnostic("sensitivity_egfr_dispersion", function() DESeq2::plotDispEsts(dds_sens_egfr))
save_diagnostic("primary_raw_pvalues", function() {
  hist(res$pvalue, breaks = 50, main = "Raw p-values", xlab = "p-value")
})
save_diagnostic("ma_unshrunken", function() {
  DESeq2::plotMA(res, alpha = 0.05, ylim = c(-5, 5), main = "Before shrinkage")
})
save_diagnostic("ma_apeglm", function() {
  DESeq2::plotMA(res_shrunk, alpha = 0.05, ylim = c(-5, 5), main = "After shrinkage (apeglm)")
})
```
